aggregation_and_uncertainty.aggregate: equal fold weight with denominator disclosure
aggregation_and_uncertainty.fold_consistency: count sign by fold descriptively; two-of-three is not certification
aggregation_and_uncertainty.uncertainty: date-block bootstrap only, resampling complete cohort dates within fold; overlapping horizons and repeated observations are not independent; insufficient dates yields null

candidate_roster: all candidates in the exact frozen manifest; no winner selection or candidate removal

classification.comparator: training-fold prevalence only where a probability baseline is meaningful
classification.direction: signed differences reported; no certification direction

probability.horizon: capture target_definition; never combine different horizons

claim_limits: prior development exposure and multiple comparisons must be disclosed

plan.semantic_content_hash_algorithm: canonical_json_hash({key:value for key,value in plan.items() if key != plan_sha256})

observation_weighting.abstention: retained in denominators; contributes no selected position
observation_weighting.fold_aggregate: equal weight across nonempty cohorts, then report folds separately and an equal-fold descriptive aggregate
observation_weighting.identity_scope: ticker/date timing groups, not verified securities
observation_weighting.no_selection_cohort: retained with candidate gross endpoint return zero; never dropped
observation_weighting.observation_metrics: one equal weight per canonical observation within candidate/fold; all validation observations remain in coverage and recall denominators
observation_weighting.within_cohort: equal weight across ticker groups; ticker means are formed first so repeated observations do not increase ticker weight
observation_weighting.within_ticker_date_timing_group: equal weight across canonical observations, independent of predictions and realized returns

question: How do the saved frozen OOF predictions compare with simple baselines on the recorded validation observations?

revision.change: distinguish exact split-plan file-byte SHA-256 from recomputed canonical semantic content SHA-256; no comparison, weighting, candidate, metric, or claim change

undefined_cases.calibration: null unless score semantics are probabilities
undefined_cases.gross_difference: null when required saved return or timing field is missing; row is reported, not removed
